args.message: All six stores collected slightly less tax than their stated rate. The collected rate is total tax paid divided by total pre-tax subtotal across all of each store's orders. Brooklyn, Los Angeles and New Orleans are almost exactly on their stated rate. San Francisco has the biggest gap (7.45% collected vs 7.5% stated), followed by Chicago (6.21% vs 6.25%).
